name: 59741 · Manhattan, MT
findings: ZIP 59741 (Manhattan) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59741 (Manhattan) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 59741 (Manhattan) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
